title: frontend / privacy.erasure_requested (v1) data payload
description: A right-to-be-forgotten request. Published to the 'frontend.events' exchange with routing key 'privacy.erasure_requested'; EVERY service consumes it, deletes or anonymizes its local slice for the masterId, and emits privacy.erased. (ADR-0009.)

requestId.description: Correlates the erasure across all services and their privacy.erased acks.

requestedBy.description: Whether the data subject or an admin initiated the erasure.

adminActor.description: The admin account when requestedBy = admin; null when self-initiated (audit attribution).
